    Bug 2066006 - Use correct list of extensions for stylelint to fix 'mach commlint --outgoing ...' r=mkmelin,freaktechnik
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D320801

diff --git a/tools/lint/stylelint.yml b/tools/lint/stylelint.yml
index 1e073dc9dfe..aeaccb3c2ad 100644
--- a/tools/lint/stylelint.yml
+++ b/tools/lint/stylelint.yml
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ stylelint:
     # Stylelint infra handles its own path filtering, so just include cwd
     include: ['.']
     exclude: []
-    extensions: ['css','']
+    extensions: ['css', 'scss']
     support-files:
         - 'package.json'
         - 'comm/**/.stylelintrc.js'
